name: Expressing Yourself
overview: Scripture calls believers to exercise wisdom and restraint in how they express themselves, highlighting that a fool's anger is quickly revealed while the prudent person conceals shame. It also warns against isolating oneself to pursue selfish desires, which can lead to meddling in matters beyond one's understanding. Furthermore, God commands His people to speak up on behalf of those who cannot defend themselves, advocating for justice and protection of the vulnerable.
